name: universal-copy
description: Copy any selection or article as Markdown, clean text or HTML, or as a quote with a link to the passage. Tables as CSV, TSV, JSON.

scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --e2e && node e2e/smoke.mjs
scripts.screenshots: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --e2e && SCREENSHOTS=1 node e2e/smoke.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm test && node scripts/package.mjs
